verdict.rationale: Vapi ships a documented public API/SDK (assistant management, calls, tools), a CLI for terminal-driven workflows, and a hosted MCP server exposing the API as tools, all confirmed by runtime probes (CLI installs and runs, MCP endpoint live and auth-gated as documented). This directly satisfies programmatic/AI-native control via a documented public interface. Missing for 10: no independent third-party developer report deeply exercising the API beyond docs/probes.
